question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH orders_2025 AS (
  SELECT ORDER_ID
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), lines_by_order AS (
  SELECT ORDER_ID, COUNT(*) AS LINE_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) AS ORDERED_UNITS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER_ITEM
  GROUP BY ORDER_ID
), order_line_status AS (
  SELECT o.ORDER_ID,
         COALESCE(l.LINE_COUNT, 0) AS LINE_COUNT,
         COALESCE(l.ORDERED_UNITS, 0) AS ORDERED_UNITS
  FROM orders_2025 o
  LEFT JOIN lines_by_order l ON o.ORDER_ID = l.ORDER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_2025_ORDERS,
       COUNT_IF(LINE_COUNT > 1) AS MULTI_LINE_ORDERS,
       COUNT_IF(LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS SHARE_MULTI_LINE_ORDERS,
       COUNT_IF(LINE_COUNT = 1) AS ONE_LINE_ORDERS,
       AVG(IFF(LINE_COUNT = 1, ORDERED_UNITS, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_ONE_LINE,
       COUNT_IF(LINE_COUNT > 1) AS MULTI_LINE_ORDER_COUNT,
       AVG(IFF(LINE_COUNT > 1, ORDERED_UNITS, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_MULTI_LINE,
       COUNT_IF(LINE_COUNT = 0) AS ORDERS_WITH_NO_ITEM_LINE
FROM order_line_status

action.answer: For 2025 recorded orders (4,359,773 total), 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 70.005686% of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for the 1,307,684 one-line orders and 3.484769 for the 3,052,089 multi-line orders. Orders with no item line: 0. Ordered units are summed line quantities; line count is the number of item-line records per order.
